Transcript Network App

Source: vignettes/transcript_network_app.Rmd
transcript_network_app.Rmd

Overview

run_transcript_network_app() launches an interactive Shiny application visualizing the relationships between speakers and topics across the Vladivideo corpus. It provides two network views:

  • Speaker-Topic Network – connects speakers to the topics discussed in their transcripts.
  • Speaker Co-Appearance Network – connects speakers who appear in the same transcript.

On the package website, the app below runs live in your browser via shinylive – a WebAssembly build of R that needs no Shiny server. It behaves the same as calling run_transcript_network_app() in RStudio or VS Code: select a speaker from the dropdown, drag nodes, zoom, and hover for details.

The first load will take a few seconds as the in-browser R packages initialize.

# To run the same app locally instead:
library(bribeR)
run_transcript_network_app()

If you’re reading this vignette outside the package website (e.g. via browseVignettes()), the embedded app above won’t load. Run run_transcript_network_app() directly instead.
